entities.name: Query protein BraB
observations: Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt O34545 from Bacillus subtilis strain 168.
Length 445 aa; calculated molecular weight 46.61 kDa; theoretical pI 9.41; GRAVY 1.03; estimated charge at pH 7 is +11.8.
Predicted and curated as a multi-pass cell/plasma-membrane protein.
Contains Pfam Branch_AA_trans (PF05525.20), spanning residues 8–432 with i-Evalue 3.1e-168.

entities.name: BraB O34545
observations: Reviewed Bacillus subtilis branched-chain amino acid permease.
Mediates uptake of isoleucine and valine and probably leucine; functions in the branched-chain amino acid transport system.
Associated with CodY activation together with BcaP and BrnQ in Bacillus subtilis.

entities.name: Branch_AA_trans PF05525
observations: Pfam domain detected from residues 8–432 with a very strong i-Evalue of 3.1e-168.
Domain supports classification as a branched-chain amino-acid transporter family member.
